newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks see-saw to end up, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks see-saw to end up, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fluctuated before ending up on Tuesday amid buying of select blue chips, but dealers said sentiment was weak and the market could open mixed on Wednesday.
"There is little room for the index to fall further but investors lack confidence due to uncertain political and economic conditions," dealer Ali Raza Monay of KAB Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 6.71 points, or 0.45 percent, to end at 1,486.21. Losers led gainers 174 to 74. The index had dropped to 1,467.51 in early trade.

Turnover rose to 44.91 million shares from 41.06 million on Monday. Faysal Bank rose 0.65 rupees to 23.90 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.80 to 35.80. Hub Power Co rose 0.10 to 34 and Pakistan State Oil 8.0 to 388. PTCL rose 0.15 to 32.15. Fauji Fertilizer fell 0.50 to 82 and ICI Pakistan 0.30 to 19.20. Lever Brothers rose 13 to 675.
